name: Lottie Player
description: Plays a Lottie (Bodymovin) JSON animation, rendered as SVG. If the file has markers named 'in', 'loop' and 'out', Play runs 'in' and then repeats 'loop' (or holds the last 'in' frame) and Stop runs 'out'. Without markers the whole animation is played (looped or once) and Stop fades it out. Size and position place the animation on screen; transparent areas stay transparent.

loop.title: Playback
loop.description: loop: repeat the whole animation until Stop. once: play it once and hold the last frame. Files with 'in'/'loop'/'out' markers follow their markers ('loop' repeats until Stop). For an animation that clears itself, use the 'Lottie Player (play once)' graphic.

size.title: Size in % of the screen
size.description: The animation is fitted (keeping its aspect ratio) into a box of this size; 100 = full screen.

customActions.name: Restart
customActions.description: Play the animation (or its 'in' part) again from the start.
